Yes — typing "space telescope" and watching it narrow straight down to the NASA link as I went is exactly the "jump right to what I meant" feeling I described. Not having to press a search button, just watching the list shrink to what matches, feels quick and right.

And the scope you picked is good: I'd want it to look across the titles, the descriptions, the site, the actual web address, and the labels — because sometimes the word I remember is in the description, or it's the label I put on, not the title. That it doesn't care about capitalization matters too; I shouldn't have to remember exactly how something was written.

Two things I'll flag for when their pieces arrive, not now: once I can jot my own little notes on a bookmark, I'd expect those notes to be searchable the same way. And I imagine wanting to zero in by a specific label sometimes rather than a loose word — but I suspect that's part of the filtering step still to come. For plain "type and it finds it," though, this is what I wanted.
